entities.name: An individual core CPQD emitter exhibits bright exciton and biexciton emission with narrow linewidths (104 and 61 µeV, ±4 µeV) and low background; power depende
entities.description: An individual core CPQD emitter exhibits bright exciton and biexciton emission with narrow linewidths (104 and 61 µeV, ±4 µeV) and low background; power dependence shows typical exciton-biexciton behavior with biexciton emission dominating after exciton saturation, and cross-correlation shows substantial bunching consistent with cascade emission.
entities.evidence_span: Figure 3 shows one example exhibiting bright exciton and biexciton photoluminescence emission with narrow linewidths of respectively 104 and 61 µeV (±4 µeV), with low background emission.

evidence_spans: Figure 3 shows one example exhibiting bright exciton and biexciton photoluminescence emission with narrow linewidths of respectively 104 and 61 µeV (±4 µeV), with low background emission.

Its excitation power dependence shows the typical exciton-biexciton behavior, with the exciton line appearing at low power, followed by the biexciton line, which becomes predominant as the exciton emission saturates and then decreases.

The origin of each line is further confirmed by the substantial bunching observed on the cross-correlation measurement (Figure 3(c))—a clear sign of a cascade emission pathway between the biexciton and exciton state.
